question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Tooth and nail
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**, i.e., "With complete determination". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Tooth and nail"** means to fight or work with complete determination, energy, and persistence, leaving no stone unturned. (पूरी दृढ़ता और उत्साह के साथ लड़ना या काम करना) • **Example:** She fought tooth and nail to secure a promotion at her workplace. • **"Determination"** refers to the quality of being resolute and working hard to achieve a goal, even in challenging situations. (दृढ़ निश्चय) • **Example:** His determination to win the race inspired everyone around him. • Hence, the idiom "Tooth and nail" aligns with the meaning "With complete determination". Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**, i.e., "With complete determination". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Without preparation** (बिना तैयारी के): Refers to doing something impromptu or without prior arrangement or practice. • **Example:** He delivered the speech without preparation and still impressed the audience. • **Option 3: Secretly** (गुप्त रूप से): Refers to doing something in a concealed or private manner, often without others knowing. • **Example:** They secretly planned a surprise party for their friend. • **Option 4: Reluctantly** (अनिच्छा से): Refers to doing something unwillingly or hesitantly. • **Example:** She reluctantly agreed to attend the meeting despite her busy schedule. 30:Ta42, The correct answer is: **Energizing**.
